org_configured.description: True once organization-specific SLA minutes, CAB blackout windows, and deflection costs are bound.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

p1_resolution_minutes.description: P1 contractual resolution SLA target in minutes (24x7).

p2_resolution_minutes.description: P2 contractual resolution SLA target in minutes (24x7).

p3_resolution_minutes.description: P3 contractual resolution SLA target in business minutes (8x5).

p4_resolution_minutes.description: P4 contractual resolution SLA target in business minutes (8x5).

sla_at_risk_pct.description: Percentage of SLA budget consumed at which active incidents flag AT_RISK.

spike_cluster_min.description: Minimum correlated open tickets per CI/error signature to declare an incident storm cluster.

cost_per_l1_ticket_usd.description: Average unit cost per L1 service desk ticket used to estimate KCS deflection savings.

expected_kcs_deflection_rate.description: Expected fraction of recurring tickets deflected by a published KCS self-service article.
